panel.title: Security audit
panel.checking_body: arch-audit is matching the Arch Security Team advisories against your installed packages.
panel.fix_only_tip: Show only advisories with a fixed version available.
row.copy_upgrade_tip: Copy sudo pacman -Syu to the clipboard.
empty.title: No known advisories
empty.body: arch-audit found no advisories affecting your installed packages.
idle.title: Not checked yet
idle.body: Run the first check to see whether any installed package has a known advisory.
waiting.title: Waiting for the service
waiting.body: The Arch Audit service has not published a result yet. It starts automatically with the plugin.
missing.title: arch-audit is not installed
missing.short: Install it to run checks; cached results are still shown.
missing.body: Arch Audit relies on the official arch-audit package to match the Arch Security Team advisories against your installed packages.
error.title: Could not check for advisories
widget.tooltip.hint: Left click details · Right click check now
notify.title: Security advisories
settings.check_hours.label: Check interval
settings.check_hours.description: Hours between automatic checks (1–168). A check also runs at startup when the cached result is older than this.
settings.notify_new.label: Notify about new advisories
settings.notify_new.description: Show a notification when a check finds advisories that were not present in the previous check. The first check never notifies.
settings.notify_min_severity.label: Minimum notification severity
settings.notify_min_severity.description: Only notify for new advisories at or above this severity.
settings.ignore_packages.label: Ignored packages
settings.ignore_packages.description: Package names to leave out of the widget and panel. An advisory stays visible while it still affects at least one non-ignored package.
settings.glyph.label: Widget glyph
settings.glyph.description: Glyph shown while advisories are present. Clean checks use shield-check and failures use shield-x.
settings.show_count.label: Show advisory count
settings.show_count.description: Show the number of advisories next to the glyph.
settings.hide_on_clean.label: Hide when clean
settings.hide_on_clean.description: Hide the widget while the last check found no advisories. Failures and missing dependencies stay visible.
